root_cause.summary: After a separate pickup-game declaration half-move, V2 incorrectly appended the ten-card Ouvert hand to the two-card discard outbound action. ISS appends/re-renders the open hand in the server echo, producing a 22-card echo that the V2 parser did not accept.
official_reference: doc/skat-game-format: discard and declaration encode material discard cards plus Ouvert visibility as applicable
SimpleState.java DISCARD_AND_DECL split half-phase accepts the material discard first and treats additional Ouvert view cards as visibility data

fix.root_change: Split declaration/discard now emits only the two material discard cards.
fix.defensive_parser: A structurally valid historical 22-card split-Ouvert echo is accepted and normalized to the canonical 12-card discard/open-hand representation.
fix.exactly_once: A pending legacy 12-card discard effect can be reconciled against its valid 22-card server echo without replay.

concurrency_note: The main worktree was concurrently dirty and failing three targeted tests at capture time; it was intentionally not overwritten.
